messages.subject: Rhipe 0.72 Error
parts:
I am able to run all the jobs using Rhipe 0.71 easily. I recently tried to move to Rhipe 0.72. I first got an error asking me to switch rhmr to rhwatch. And I did exactly that. But then When I started the job I got the following error. Wondering if anyone can throw some light on this.
 
Error in Rhipe:::.rhmr(map = map, reduce = reduce, combiner = combiner, :could not find function "input"

Thank YOu
Ashrith

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe 0.72 Error
parts:
Hmm,

rhwatch uses input and output for input folders and output folders. See ?rhwatch
also, see rhfmt for specifying the input to 'input'. By default

input="path to something" assumes sequence file input format.
If you want text input  fornat, you need input=rhfmt(path-to-input, type='text')

see rhoptions()$ioformats$text for what options you can pass.

Regards
Saptarshi
